name: devflow
description: worklog: a time ledger for feature work, fed by Claude Code and Codex hooks

scripts.test: rm -rf dist-test && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test dist-test/test/*.test.js
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run check:dist
scripts.link: chmod +x dist/cli.js && mkdir -p ~/.local/bin && ln -sfn "$PWD/dist/cli.js" ~/.local/bin/worklog && echo linked ~/.local/bin/worklog
scripts.check:dist: rm -rf .dist-check && tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir .dist-check && diff -r dist .dist-check; rc=$?; rm -rf .dist-check; exit $rc
